awardHistory.summary: The Coleman Medal was first presented in 1981. In 2001 the AFL retrospectively recognised leading goalkickers from 1955–1980 as Coleman Medallists. League leaders from 1897–1954 were recognised as Leading Goalkicker Medallists.
